Title: Document 3
Content: French postcard, showing colonial troops in France and French civilians, `text(1915)`. The text of the card says: “Our Black troops in the Great War `text(1914)text(1915)` [say]: 'What are we doing here?! ... We came to kill savages* ... the German ones!'”
References: a reference to the fact that German wartime propaganda often depicted colonial troops in the French and British armies as savages
